message.content:
A magazine cover titled "TEMPO" in large red block letters sits at the top. The background is a dark blue gradient. Below the title, two men wearing glasses are illustrated playing a game of chess. The man on the left, with dark hair and a black shirt, rests his chin on his left hand while reaching his right hand toward a chess piece. The man on the right, shown from a side profile wearing a red shirt, looks toward the board.

The chessboard is unusually shaped like a map of Jakarta, with gold-colored edges. It features a black and white checkered pattern and various chess pieces. A large gold queen piece stands near the center-left, with a gold knight nearby. Several red pawn-like pieces are scattered across the board.

Text on the cover includes "Sengkarut Pembangkit Listrik Dahlan Iskan H.70" and "Skema Memutus Monopoli PLN H.82" at the top. To the right, "BEREBUT ANAK ABAH" is in large white letters, followed by smaller text starting with "Ridwan Kamil dan Pramono Anung bersaing..." A barcode and QR code are in the upper right corner.
